newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Barco buys Danish Re Group.
newsitem.headline: Barco buys Danish Re Group.

text.p: Belgian Barco Group said on Thursday it was buying Danish Re Group for 128.5 million Danish crowns (697.5 million Belgian francs).
It said the deal extended its digital product range for the video and communications world.
Re Group makes digital video and audio encoders and decoders which allow digital video and audio signals to be compressed and then reformatted before being transmitted via the telecomms network.
It employs 235 people and had turnover of 248 million crowns in the year to June 30, 1996. It has subsidiaries in Great Britain, Germany, the U.S., Malaysia and Australia.
The company fits in with Barco Communications Systems, which specialises in studio monitors and cable TV equipment.
